name: SSH MCP Server
description: Enables remote server administration via SSH, supporting command execution, SFTP file transfers, and multi-profile management. It features security safeguards like destructive command detection and audit logging to ensure safe interaction with remote Linux/Unix environments.

SSH_PROFILES_PATH.description: Optional path to the profiles.json configuration file. Defaults to the local directory.

SSH_PASSWORD_STAGING.description: SSH password for the 'staging' profile defined in profiles.json.

SSH_PASSWORD_PRODUCTION.description: SSH password for the 'production' profile defined in profiles.json.
